answer: Assembling that for 134 aliases means 134 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each pearl escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the horizon ledger records every share and the glacier audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
